title: Kenworth T909 Hi-tensile Road Train aluminium FUPS Bullbar #19b
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar 381 style channel with skirt. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm box uprights shown. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to all for maximum dimension combinations. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Optional Dangerous Goods sign. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
